name: Ludot
source:
Likes: Cheese
Specialty: Wine tasting

An aide to Emperor Ruslan of the Aurorian Empire.
He admires Ruslan and is prepared to do anything for Auroria. He lives under a false identity as the emperor's body double.
In reality, he has a surprisingly earnest and serious side.
